canonical_source.behavior: ClearFiltersAsync clears the grid search text, resets the current page to 1, raises SearchChanged with an empty value, then invokes the caller ClearFiltersRequested callback.

semantics: clear the applied grid search and visible search input
reset pagination to page 1 before callback execution
raise the adapted SearchChanged empty value
clear applied site/status/correlation filters through the caller callback
perform a fresh authoritative unfiltered tenant read
render nothing when no effective search/filter is active
suppress duplicate activation while the authoritative workspace is busy

authorization_and_isolation.tenant_context: server-provided FrontendContext endpoint plus backend tenant boundary

coverage: exact source ordering for input clear, page reset, SearchChanged, and ClearFiltersRequested
Email History integration performs fresh unfiltered page-1 tenant request
filtered then unfiltered authoritative tenant reads

terminality.basis: The Laravel shared control preserves the source AppDataGrid ClearFiltersAsync ordering and is wired to a real tenant-scoped Email History consumer whose clear callback performs an authoritative unfiltered reread. Focused frontend and PHP tests prove the canonical marker, read-only semantics, and tenant fail-closed behavior.
